message.content:
LeBron James (born December 30, 1984) is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes ever. He played high school ball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School in Akron, Ohio, and was drafted first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003. Over his career he has won four NBA championships—two with Miami Heat (2012 & 2013), one with Cleveland Cavaliers (2016), and another with Los Angeles Lakers (2020)—and earned numerous MVP awards.

Beyond the court, LeBron is known for philanthropy; his “I Promise” program supports education initiatives for children in underserved communities. He's also active in media and entertainment, producing films through SpringHill Entertainment and starring in movies such as *Space Jam: A New Legacy*. His influence extends into social activism, particularly around racial justice issues.
